phaseGates.finalQuietRule: 1000 consecutive actual200Hz source integrations/5s from measured fixed entry anchors; source strict standing and≤5deg; no longest-window substitution

phaseGates.quietDeadlineTie: success at exactly8s precedes intrinsic deadline if the actual final1000sample quiet condition is met; physical failure always wins

reward.formula: weighted mean of exp(-0.5*mean((error/scale)^2)) terms minus costs, plus ordered one-time actual event bonuses
reward.partialPhysicalTerminalRule: dense and normalized effort/change costs scaled by count/5, actual measured slip cost retained, no event bonus, full physicalFailurePenalty; no bootstrap
reward.measurementReduction: post-interval measured finite endpoint errors against the pre-action held target/reference twist; controls are actual normalized actuator controls at the post-interval boundary (and previous boundary for change cost), never held student residuals; slip is sum of actual per-foot cumulative increments; events use all consecutive native samples
reward.rotationConvention: world-frame SO(3) geodesic rotvec Log(R_actual*R_target.T), radians, normalized rotations; no Euler-component subtraction
reward.loadedSlipReduction: sum of nonnegative actual per-foot cumulative loaded-slip increments; not maximum; no reset within episode
reward.controlCostUnits: actual normalized actuator controls in both teacher and student; never student residual radians

errorFrames.comHeightErrorM: actual native worldY COM minus target true COM height

termination.truncationObservation: actual final observation/reference, never reset observation
physicalFailures: COM outside original safety height envelope
termination.flightDefinition: both measured foot normal loads<3N in any native sample
termination.timeouts: intrinsic phase wall/goal deadline is terminal0 with failure penalty; extrinsic pilot physics/wall/collection cutoff truncates with actual final state and bootstrap1; interrupted/unverified request excluded

termination.invalidObservation: nonfinite/corrupt observations abort/save collection, never replay invalid tensors
termination.interfootOverlap: minimum distance across all four capsule segment pairs minus both radii; negative is physical interfoot_overlap, no imaginary contact

curriculum.reduceOnlyAfter: ten consecutive deterministic full physical acceptance trials at the current fixed power; all pass; no source return60 threshold

admissionRequired: actual source control initialization strategy reviewed
fitted actor actual200Hz held40Hz stance benchmark completed without parity or immediate physical failure; supervised error alone is insufficient
critic-only exact Polyak and frozen actor/alpha optimizer regression tests
pilot.warmupBehavior: chosen candidate: separately fitted SLOW-derived actual normalized actuator torque labels at power1, frozen fitted actor plus Gaussian std.02 during replay warmup; clip once to original normalized power bound; no fallback to WEAK without new decision
pilot.afterWarmupBehavior: same source stochastic tanh Gaussian sampler, initial logstd=ln(.02) constant, source learned bounds[-5,2]; physical gear unchanged
pilot.stopRollback: any known quiet/GetUp regression or failed paired safety check; no blind retuning

pilot.hashAdmission: future runner must match externally pinned expected config SHA256 and task/reference/native/actor code hashes BEFORE collection; computing the current hash alone is not admission

initializer.data: 200 original40Hz decision starts in actual SLOW final5s; labels source integrations2401+20*n for n0..199, inputs PRE packets2400+20*n; first120pairs (3s) fit, final80pairs (2s) heldout; same fixed actual row6400 entry target25 for all118 inputs; no original SLOW target reuse
initializer.targets: FIRST800Hz substep actual normalized actuator control of each40Hz SLOW decision, checked controlsActuatorOrder against qfrc_actuator_t[6:][ORDER]/gear_actuator; input physicalObservation_(t-1); NO averaging or same-row poststate labels; held200Hz approximation remains unproven
initializer.actorSource: audited WEAK68-to118 mean-network expansion as initialization only; reference columns zero; no residual-head-as-torque conversion
initializer.fitObjective: mean squared source raw mu versus atanh(clip(actual_u,-1+1e-6,1-1e-6)); logstd outputs held constant ln(.02)
initializer.logstdInitialization: ln(.02), raw logstd constant atanh((ln(.02)+1.5)/3.5); zero final logstd weights, exclude their bias from supervised changes
initializer.interpretation: approximate new direct-torque warm start, not equivalent to800Hz SLOW policy or a trained strong-stage asset
initializer.onAdmissionFailure: stop and preserve result; no automatic WEAK fallback or extra optimizer budget
initializer.saturatedLabelRule: epsilon=1e-6 fixed; report count; any abs(u)>=1-epsilon aborts candidate fitting rather than silently changing labels
initializer.validationReduction: RMS over heldout80x21 normalized actuator entries; maximum absolute entrywise; deterministic tanh(mu) at power1; additionally report perjoint RMS/max and originalgear-scaled Nm error
initializer.noiseInterpretation: ln(.02) is latent pre-tanh Gaussian std; output control noise is state-dependent after tanh; warmup .02 additive normalized-control noise is a separately declared override
